title: manettia calycosa var. scaberrima
intro: Manettia calycosa var. scaberrima, commonly known as Yellow Jamaica Dogwood, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is native to the Caribbean region and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various health conditions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids have been identified in the plant, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancer properties.
